nvlink_infiniband.mnemonic: NVLink = iNside the box (N = iNternal). InfiniBand = Infinite distance Between boxes.
nvlink_infiniband.visual_cue: NVLink is the cable connecting GPUs INSIDE the DGX chassis. InfiniBand is the thick cable plugged into the BACK of the DGX going to the rack switch.

mig_mps.mnemonic: MIG = Mighty Iron Gate (a hardware WALL between tenants). MPS = Maybe Partial Separation (a software CURTAIN — not a wall).
mig_mps.visual_cue: MIG is a brick wall with padlocks. MPS is a shower curtain. Both separate spaces — only one actually provides privacy.

dcgm_slurm.mnemonic: DCGM = Doctor for GPUs (runs diagnostics, monitors vitals). Slurm = Scheduler for jobs (decides who gets GPU time).
dcgm_slurm.visual_cue: DCGM is the hospital monitoring system showing patient vitals. Slurm is the appointment scheduler deciding which patients get the operating room.

dcgm_base_command.mnemonic: DCGM = the speedometer and engine light (tells you what's happening with the GPU). Base Command = the mission control platform (schedules flights, manages crew, tracks all missions).
dcgm_base_command.visual_cue: DCGM reports GPU health metrics to a dashboard. Base Command is the entire airport operations system that INCLUDES those metrics among many other functions.

tensorrt_triton.mnemonic: TensorRT = Turbocharger (makes the engine faster, produces a tuned engine file). Triton = the Track (where the tuned car actually RACES, serving requests).
tensorrt_triton.visual_cue: TensorRT is the pit crew that tunes the race car. Triton is the race circuit the car runs on for every API request.

dpu_gpu.mnemonic: DPU = Data center Plumber (handles pipes: networking, storage, security plumbing). GPU = Giant Parallel Universe of matrix math.
dpu_gpu.visual_cue: GPU is the scientist in the lab doing AI research. DPU is the building maintenance team managing the electricity, water, and security so the scientist can work.

nvswitch_nvlink.mnemonic: NVLink = the individual roads between cities. NVSwitch = the highway interchange that connects all roads to all other roads simultaneously.
nvswitch_nvlink.visual_cue: NVLink is a direct highway between two specific GPUs. NVSwitch is the ring road junction that lets any GPU reach any other without going through a third.

slurm_kubernetes.mnemonic: Slurm = the factory shift manager (batch jobs, queue, clock in/out, resource accounting). Kubernetes = the restaurant orchestrator (keeps containers running, serves requests on-demand).
slurm_kubernetes.visual_cue: Slurm manages workers doing big batch jobs that take hours. Kubernetes manages microservices that respond to requests in milliseconds.

bmc_dcgm.mnemonic: BMC = the building's emergency generator (works even when the power is out, i.e., even when OS is down). DCGM = the building management software (only works when power is on).
bmc_dcgm.visual_cue: BMC is hardware — it has its own power rail. DCGM is software that needs drivers and OS. If the OS crashes, BMC still lets you power-cycle the server. DCGM cannot.

fp16_bf16.mnemonic: BF16 = Big exponent Float (same 8-bit exponent as FP32, safe dynamic range). FP16 = Fragile Precision (5-bit exponent, can overflow, needs a loss scaling safety net).
fp16_bf16.visual_cue: BF16 is a slightly smaller copy of FP32 — same range, just less detail. FP16 is a different shape — narrower range, needs extra care.

base_command_slurm.mnemonic: Base Command is Slurm's boss — it manages multiple Slurm clusters. Slurm is the worker. Never say Base Command REPLACES Slurm; it USES it.
base_command_slurm.visual_cue: Slurm is the engine. Base Command Platform is the dashboard, steering wheel, and GPS navigation that uses the engine.

mig_instances.mnemonic: 7 MIG instances, 8 GPUs per DGX. The exam will use both numbers. Anchor: MIG max = SEVEN (lucky number, not eight).
mig_instances.visual_cue: A100 has 7 maximum MIG slices because 7 × ~10 GB ≈ 70 GB of the 80 GB total. The remaining 10 GB is for management overhead.
